cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — standing; A sheltered roof above a far-future monorail corridor at night — She tests a paper glider on a narrow bench; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — holds a towel folded against her chest; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds her keepsake at chest height; A civilian orbital reading room lit by the first pale dawn light — She uses an optical viewer to decipher the folds of a paper puzzle; her bedroom — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — reads a book held open in both hands; a cedar-wood tub by the window of a mountain inn — perched on a ledge or edge; long mossy stone steps climbing to the carved gate of a mountain sect — kneeling on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — writes with a calligraphy brush and an ink stone on rice paper laid flat on the table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips
